review_kind: Independent actual review of seven fully rendered offline runtime pages

pages.observation: Dedicated synthetic Summary Sheet is coherent and explicitly disclaims real competition results; its reserved whitespace is reasonable for this test.
Readable sparse table of contents. Its shortness is a consequence of the small test; it is not the same issue as an avoidably empty body page.

Figure 1 vertical Response (dimensionless) label is clipped by the source figure boundary. High-resolution independent source-PDF rendering confirms this predates the width repair. Other body text and caption are readable.
Response surface axes/kPa colorbar and same-grid planar contour remain readable at insertion size; Synthetic footer and caption are intact; no apparent clipping or overlap.

Only two short sections occupy the top of the body page, followed by a large unused area before the full-page trajectory. This is avoidable internal whitespace; condense the demonstration body without shrinking the 3D figures or inventing scientific content.
Physical x/y/z axes in meters, Time (s) colorbar, square/triangle endpoints, XY/XZ readouts, Synthetic footer and caption are readable and intact; no apparent overlap or clipping.
Short references and AI-use explanation are readable; trailing end-matter whitespace is expected for this limited demonstration, not a full paper assessment.

diff: The repair should reduce only its inclusion width and preserve all curve values.

findings.origin: Present in unchanged source figure; not introduced by clamping insertion width.
findings.evidence: Full assembled page plus independent high-resolution render of the original source PDF, both actually inspected.
findings.repair_direction: Regenerate only the synthetic figure layout/shorten the axis label while preserving the dimensionless unit and all arrays; do not shrink typography or alter curve values.

findings.problem: Large avoidable blank body area between short explanatory paragraphs and the deferred trajectory page.
findings.origin: Full-page float and forced page clear in a very short demonstration.
findings.repair_direction: Clearly label the document as a compact presentation test, group its explanatory content, then retain full-size 3D sample pages. Preserve the official project template structure and scientific content.

limits: This is a short synthetic layout rehearsal, not a complete scientific competition paper or model-validation result.
Full-size 3D sample pages pass this visual scope, but they do not make the whole seven-page document visually acceptable.
